t.eng-ummmuhammad: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
ayahs.translit: Ma aghna AAanhu maluhu wama kasaba

t.eng-ummmuhammad: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained
He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber
